summary: Treat every non-gray cell as a traversable graph cell. In up/down/left/right BFS order, find the shortest path from red 2 to green 3 and then from green 3 to yellow 4. Clear every traversable cell not selected by those two ordered paths, paint the selected route cyan 8, and preserve all gray 5 walls.
